subject: Kickoff: term uplift & capacity alignment — QBR window + runbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Park <ellis.park@lumina.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: term uplift & capacity alignment — QBR window + runbook

Hi Ellis / Lumina team,

Thanks for the time on the renewal preview call last week. Per our conversation, this thread is to kick off the renewal & expansion coordination for the upcoming contract window. High level asks below: 

- Confirm whether the proposed 12‑month term with a 20% additional committed capacity is acceptable.
- Identify the internal Lumina stakeholders we should loop into the QBR (tech, procurement, finance).
- Lock a 90‑minute QBR date in late Oct / early Nov so we can present the MAP and next‑steps runbook.

Attached: MAP-Lumina-v2.pdf — mutual action plan draft; capacity-runbook.txt — high level runbook for scaling/transition; I will also drop a short slide deck for the QBR once we lock a date.

Proposed QBR windows (PT):
- Tue Oct 26, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Oct 27, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Nov 4, 09:00–10:30

Next steps for us internally: Ben to validate capacity runbook details; Soojin to prepare QBR slides and invite list; Jonas to own procurement redline coordination.

Ellis — can you confirm which of the proposed windows work and who from Lumina should be on calendar?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555‑0192

Attachment: MAP-Lumina-v2.pdf (summary of objectives and milestones)

From: Ellis Park <ellis.park@lumina.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumina.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 12:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff: term uplift & capacity alignment — QBR window + runbook

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. We like the MAP draft and the idea of a 12‑month term with additional committed capacity, but I need to confirm internal budget signoff.

Quick answers:
- Tentatively ok on the 20% capacity uplift but will confirm with finance by Oct 5.
- Proposed QBR windows: Tue Oct 26 (10:00 PT) works best for the exec/tech group.
- Attendees: myself (Head of ML Ops), Priya Desai (VP Product), and Procurement (procurement@lumina.ai). We may add a data‑security lead if the team wants to touch on private deployment considerations.

We received the MAP-Lumina-v2.pdf. Please include a short demo of the Dedicated capacity headroom during the QBR.

Best,

Ellis Park
Head of ML Ops, Lumina Health
ellis.park@lumina.ai

---
Procurement: please coordinate any procurement paperwork timelines against the Oct 26 QBR; happy to loop legal after our QBR if needed.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellis Park <ellis.park@lumina.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: term uplift & capacity alignment — QBR window + runbook

Marissa / team — I ran the numbers against Lumina's current throughput profile and the proposed +20% commit. Notes below: 

- Expected steady‑state token throughput increases by ~18% with the suggested binning & autoscale policy.
- Cost delta vs current commit: ~+13% monthly spend; we can offset ~5% via tighter KV caching and short‑sequence quantization recommendations.
- Risk: if Lumina increases long‑context inference >1.5x traffic, we should consider a transient burst buffer (Dedicated burst pool) to maintain 99th percentile latency SLA.

I've attached a short QBR slide snippet (qbr-slide-deck.pptx) with graphs and the runbook excerpt. If Ellis wants, we can demo the burst buffer on Oct 26 as part of the QBR (15–20 minute tech segment).

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: qbr-slide-deck.pptx (selected slides for capacity & cost delta)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Thanks all — locking the QBR on Tue Oct 26, 10:00–11:30 PT (invites sent to the attendees Ellis listed).

Agenda (90 min):
1) 10:00 — Introductions & renewal objectives (Marissa, Ellis)
2) 10:10 — MAP walkthrough and milestone timeline (Marissa)
3) 10:25 — Technical capacity & burst demo (Ben) — 15–20 minutes
4) 10:45 — Commercial terms & committed capacity discussion (Jonas)
5) 11:05 — Procurement next steps & timeline (Jonas + Procurement)
6) 11:20 — Open Q&A and action items

I uploaded a live MAP and the QBR slide deck to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAP-Lumina — please review and add comments by Oct 18. HubSpot deal is HS-987654 — I added the meeting and the MAP as attachments in HubSpot.
